title_zh: 先查档案再说明历史人物身份

scenario.label_zh: 核对历史人物的展览用语
scenario.goal_zh: 区分雇佣仆役和被奴役者，决定先查人物记录再写说明

context_zh: 课堂模拟博物馆项目中，两名学生为一幅虚构历史人物画像拟写标签，避免把不同劳动身份混为一谈。
author: author-phase06-b

sentences.speaker: Dorian
sentences.text: The note calls him a servant in a royal household. Should our label say he was employed at the palace?

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: It doesn't tell us which building he worked in, or whether he was paid. What else does it say?

sentences.speaker: Dorian
sentences.text: The family made money from overseas trade, including the sale of enslaved people. Does that mean he was a slave?

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: Not necessarily. A servant could be employed, while a slave was treated as property and denied freedom. We need evidence about this person.

sentences.speaker: Dorian
sentences.text: So we don't know the truth about his situation from this note alone.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: Exactly. Let's check the household records in our source pack before we write the label.

sentences.speaker: Dorian
sentences.text: I'll look for his name in those records. For now, I'll leave the claim about his status out.

targets.sense_zh: 被当作财产并剥夺自由的奴隶
